Assumption Diagnostics for because Models

Source: R/bayesian_diagnostics.R
bayesian_diagnostics.Rd

A suite of diagnostic functions for testing regression and DAG/SEM assumptions in because models.

Diagnostics evaluate posterior parameter covariance geometry and posterior predictive discrepancies.

Included diagnostics:

  • check_collinearity / bvif: Leamer's Bayesian Variance Inflation Factor and posterior parameter correlation matrix.

  • check_normality / plot_qq: Bayesian Q-Q check with empirical posterior predictive simulation envelopes and skewness/kurtosis discrepancies.

  • check_homoscedasticity: Binned posterior residual standard deviations across fitted values and variance ratio discrepancies.

  • check_residual_structure: Posterior distribution of the Variance Partition Coefficient (\(\lambda_{\text{Bayes}}\)) for phylogenetic or spatial random effects.

  • check_model: Unified multi-panel diagnostic dashboard.
